response.original_title: Sanber: vivencias de un bajo mundo
response.overview: A documentary that, through a story of parallels, seeks every possible nuance of a small piece of downtown Bogotá: a microcosm that intertwines and dies with the city's renewal. Graffiti, rap and literature (Mario Mendoza) bring never-before-told accounts of what once happened in one of the marginalized neighborhoods of central Bogotá.
response.title: Sanber: vivencias de un bajo mundo
